scope: Bounded review of whether the August 4 Airtel Kenya report refers uniquely to the Nxtra Tatu City campus. New ITWeb reporting is identity and event context only. No source is normalized into current construction while access and authority clearance remain unresolved.

candidate.name: Nxtra Tatu City Kenya Data Center Campus / NB01 / NBO1
candidate.one_campus_scope: Retain the original v97 keys. NB01 and NBO1 are operator spellings of the same Tatu City campus, not two sites or phases. No planned Mombasa, Lagos or other Airtel facility is merged or added.

identity_review.decision: Supported as an explicitly analyst-inferred association, not literal wording in the TNX article.
steps: The preserved Airtel Africa portfolio names its Kenyan hyperscale development at Tatu City near Nairobi. Its historical September 2025 announcement and future Q1 2027 forecast supply identity only, not a fresh physical observation.
The exact Nxtra project page and its reciprocal Kenya map record bind Tatu City to NB01/NBO1 and one operator-authored campus point. A generic map viewport and unrelated country records are excluded.

Nixon Kanali's original August 4 ITWeb Africa report explicitly identifies Nxtra at Tatu City, discusses Djibril Tobe, and places his remarks at the Monday Bizna Wallet launch in Nairobi. It changes the completion target from Q1 2027 to July 2027.

The previously preserved TNX report's credited event caption identifies the same August 3 Bizna Wallet launch in Nairobi. Its country-level project description and July-next-year forecast align with the ITWeb report. The author and event connection, named executive, exact forecast and primary portfolio together support one Kenyan hyperscale-campus association.
identity_review.literal_naming_limit: TNX does not literally name Nxtra, Tatu City, NB01 or NBO1. Those names must be attributed to the operator and ITWeb sources, with the cross-article association labelled as analyst inference.
identity_review.reporting_authority_limit: The reports concern remarks at a product launch, not a reporter's inspection of the construction site. ITWeb is original attributed reporting by Nixon Kanali, not a company disclosure. TechTrendsKE's same-author article is not counted as a second independent reporter.
identity_review.not_a_status_upgrade: The new ITWeb article establishes project and event context but reports historical groundbreaking, future services and a completion forecast. It supplies no independently selected current physical-work observation.

new_public_identity_source.title: Airtel shifts Nxtra completion deadline
new_public_identity_source.author: Nixon Kanali
new_public_identity_source.date_basis: NewsArticle.datePublished and article:published_time agree; the article visibly carries August 4, 2026. This is publication time, not a measured construction day.
new_public_identity_source.factual_summary: The report identifies Nxtra at Tatu City, associates Tobe with Monday's Nairobi Bizna Wallet launch, and reports a July 2027 completion forecast. These are identity, event and future-schedule facts only.

source_pointers.scope: NewsArticle author, headline and datePublished metadata
Visible article paragraph begins the sentence associating Tobe with the Monday Nairobi launch
Server-rendered article body names Nxtra and Tatu City; this long HTML line also includes unrelated layout, which is not selected

new_public_identity_source.access_review: Full article body was available through ordinary public web reading and credential-free HTTP 200. No isAccessibleForFree or paywall marker occurs in this saved response. No login, subscription, embedded-media retrieval or alternate restricted route was used.
new_public_identity_source.rights: ITWeb footer asserts copyright and all rights reserved. Only compact restated identity/event facts and attribution are retained in the repository. No article body, photograph or other media is redistributed; no open licence is asserted.

superseding_tnx_access_review.new_material_finding: The previously saved TNX response itself marks the relevant body as access-restricted. The earlier characterization as an unconditionally open syndicated publication is therefore not retained for selection.

hasPart isAccessibleForFree is the string False

The previously discussed construction paragraph lies inside that restricted container; no additional body text is quoted here

superseding_tnx_access_review.selection_decision: Do not select the construction assertion from this access-flagged body. An ordinary HTTP 200 capture and an earlier web-reader extraction do not by themselves clear the explicit restriction. No browser-visible public-access clearance was established in this review.
superseding_tnx_access_review.authority_semantics_if_later_cleared: The prior report attributes an ongoing-construction assertion to the named executive in reported speech. It is not a verbatim executive construction quotation or a reporter's own on-site observation. No universal verbatim-only rule is introduced, but authority, identity and lawful public-access clearance remain separate gates.
superseding_tnx_access_review.date_semantics_if_later_cleared: August 4 is the report date. The event caption says August 3 and the metadata records a later August 5 modification. None is a measured exact site-work day. No lifecycle date is selected in this packet.
superseding_tnx_access_review.restrictions_respected: No further TNX request, canonical Standard paywall extraction, subscription attempt, alternate client or YouTube retry was performed after detecting this concern. Prior frozen captures and packets are preserved unchanged.

executive_authority_review.review: Complete independent authority packet read. The exact Airtel Kenya corporate-account appointment post is a useful lead, but its enclosing details section is access-flagged, the post is edited, and independent operator-domain account linkage was not established. The packet expressly withholds unconditional authority clearance.
executive_authority_review.role_precision: The appointment lead uses Managing Director; do not silently equate that title with CEO or add an organizational role to core data.
executive_authority_review.status_effect: No physical-status upgrade follows from a corporate appointment even if its separate access and account-authenticity gates later close.

preserved_locator_dependencies.geometry_scope: The prior proposal's literal operator point remains only a campus reference point in WGS84. Its five decimal places do not establish horizontal accuracy. It is not a survey, boundary, entrance, parcel centroid or exact current-work footprint.
preserved_locator_dependencies.rights_scope: The operator's all-rights-reserved terms remain distinct from Google's coordinate documentation licence. Only an isolated source-authored coordinate and compact identity facts are proposed by the prior packet; no operator HTML, code, imagery or map tiles are redistributed.
preserved_locator_dependencies.dedup_scope: The prior locator reviewer checked all 162 selected full geometries and existing v97 keys. That review is referenced, not misrepresented as a newly repeated spatial audit here. No new geometry or campus is proposed in this round.

successor_and_exclusion_review.forecast_not_completion: The initial Q1 2027 and newer July 2027 schedules are forecasts, not evidence of a completed or operating facility. The new report does not support adding planned phases or capacity.
successor_and_exclusion_review.audio_not_selected: The prior root review found no direct executive physical-work statement in the official podcast segment. Non-audited ASR and the host's question do not close this gap.
successor_and_exclusion_review.standing_pages_not_redated: The operator map, portfolio, undated project page and retrieval times are identity/locator context only. They do not refresh the September 2025 construction announcement.
successor_and_exclusion_review.no_new_successor_claim: The prior bounded operator successor search is preserved. No exhaustive guarantee of no later completion or cancellation is claimed.

remaining_gates: A genuinely access-cleared, qualifying physical-work observation within the fixed window, or legitimate public-rendered clearance of the already identified report without bypassing its restriction.
An independently cleared authority basis for the specifically attributed executive statement if that report is to supply lifecycle evidence.
